rebuttal_or_critique: I maintain my position that the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance is no longer appropriate. With the repo rate at 6.50% and core inflation at 4.90%, the policy is already sufficiently restrictive. The headline inflation spike is clearly driven by food supply shocks, which are beyond the reach of interest rate adjustments. Continuing to signal 'withdrawal of accommodation' when the policy is already restrictive risks an unnecessary sacrifice of growth momentum. While I acknowledge the committee's preference for the current stance, I must dissent on the stance to reflect that the policy cycle has reached a point of balance.
